guideTabTitle: How to Submit a Project & Rate Entries
guideTabSubtitle: All submissions undergo automated validation. Below are the required title prefixes, [rating](0-100) scoring rules, and link standards.
guidePrefixTitle: Required GitHub Submission Title Format (Prefix + Name)
guidePrefixDesc: When creating an Issue or Pull Request, the submission title must start with the lowercase project type followed by a colon:
guideRule1Desc: Icons must be .svg, .png, or .jpg URLs. Screenshots must be direct .png or .jpg URLs (or left empty if none).
guideRule2Title: 2. Validated Country (or Europa, USA, Asia, Africa) & Source Host
guideRule2Desc: Enter a valid country or choose Europa, USA, Asia, or Africa. Open source links are verified against the selected platform (GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, SourceForge, Gitee, CNB), or marked Proprietary.
guideRule3Title: 3. Website Link or Project Fallback URL
guideRule3Desc: Every project links to its official website, or automatically falls back to its repository or related project page.
guideRule4Desc: You can provide descriptions in multiple languages. Users rate projects from 0 to 100 by ending their Issue comment with [rating](0-100).
submitTabTitle: How to Submit a Project: Step-by-Step Guide & Validator
submitTabSubtitle: Follow the 4 simple steps below: fill in the form fields, pass the instant validator, and submit in one click.
animTitle: Step-by-Step Guide: From Filling to Publication
animStep1Text: Choose a category (launcher, mod, server, etc.), enter name, website, and description in English or community languages.
animStep2Text: The form automatically checks URL validity, logo format, and country. All 4 checklist items must turn green.
animStep3Text: Click the 'Proceed to GitHub' button — a fully pre-filled submission issue template opens on GitHub.
animStep4Text: MeowProject Bot verifies the submission, opens a PR, and once approved, the project appears live in the catalog!
formTitle: Validate & Prepare Project Before Proceeding to GitHub
formSubtitle: Complete the fields below — the validator checks every rule and generates your direct GitHub submission link.

guideSectionFieldsDesc: List platforms separated by commas (Windows, macOS, Linux, etc.). Enter feature highlights and screenshot captions one per line.
mobileBlockedDesc: MeowProject is not optimized for mobile smartphones (Android and iOS). Due to technical and financial constraints, a mobile version is not supported yet. Please open the catalog from a desktop PC or laptop for the full experience.
screenTooSmallDesc: The MeowProject catalog is designed for full-sized desktop displays. Please maximize your browser window or increase your display resolution (minimum 1024px width).
blockedRequiredDevice: Required device: PC or Laptop (screen width 1024px or higher)
expensesSubtitle: MeowProject is an open non-commercial community project. We transparently publish all expenditures and funding goals.
spentDesc: Website creation, initial catalog compilation, and hosting / CDN infrastructure.
nextGoalDesc: Annual domain renewal (1 year) to keep the project online, fast, and accessible.
futureGoalTitle: Dedicated Translation Platform for Ukrainian Localization
futureGoalDesc: Launching a dedicated web service with tools for creators and community members to translate Minecraft launchers, mods, and documentation into Ukrainian.
verifiedDesc: This project has undergone a complete manual and technical security audit by MeowProject. Its open-source code has been verified free of malware, viruses, trojans, or credential stealing. This product is 100% trustworthy and safe for your system and Minecraft accounts.
verifiedTooltip: Click to view security verification details
privacyModalText: MeowProject is a non-profit open-source directory. We collect ZERO personal data: no account registration, no passwords, no trackers, and no advertising cookies. All comments and reviews are submitted voluntarily via GitHub Issues.
termsModalText: Minecraft is a registered trademark of Mojang Synergies AB and Microsoft Corporation. MeowProject is not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft. All launcher, mod, and server logos and titles belong to their respective creators. The website code is licensed under GPL-3.0.
